messages:
Alex M.: Quick sketch — proposal for a small dashboard to track queued-sampler / continuous-batching health. Noticed 95p token latency drift correlated with KV-cache churn earlier today.
Jordan C.: +1. Can you list the panels you want? I can wire up queries.
Alex M.: Panels I had in mind:
- batch_size histogram (5m / 1h)
- queue_wait latency heatmap by route
- scheduler efficiency = served_tokens / scheduled_tokens (1m rate)
- kvcache hit-rate + eviction spikes overlay
- kernel-choice distribution (fp16 / int8 / fallback) by seq_len buckets

Tina L.: Important: show per-route KPIs (embed vs generate) — embedding requests have different batchable shapes. Keep route filter up top.
Alex M.: Agreed. Also add a small panel that shows recent perf regression alerts from perf-bot so SRE/product can correlate.
perf-bot: [alert] 1811234502 - token_tail_latency_p95 crossed 320ms for /v1/generate in prod-us-east.
Jordan C.: For queries, I recommend PromQL: 
```
sum(rate(server_batch_size_bucket[5m])) by (le, route)
```
and for queue wait heatmap: 
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(queue_wait_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
```
Kai R.: Kernel-choice needs sampling from runtime exporter because we do handoffs mid-request. Suggest metric `kernel_selected{model,seq_bucket}` incremented at kernel bind time. Then `rate(kernel_selected[1m])` split by seq_bucket gives us drift.
Tina L.: On KV-cache, we should surface `kvcache_hit_ratio` and `kvcache_evictions_total` on same time axis. When evictions spike we saw batch sizes drop ~30% and tail up.
Alex M.: UX note: add an annotation layer for deploys and canary rollouts. Also a small table with top routes sorted by p95 latency and avg batch size.
Jordan C.: I'll mock the dashboard and push a dashboard JSON to grafana repo. Will add links to alert rules: token_tail_latency_p95, scheduler_efficiency_low.
Alex M.: Thanks — after mock I'll run a 1h profile with `perf-trace` on one affected node and attach flamegraphs. Quick follow-ups: Kai, can you add kernel_selected exporter in runtime? small counter, label seq_bucket and kernel.
Kai R.: Yep — patch incoming this afternoon. Will instrument kernel bind fast-path and fallback label.
Tina L.: I'll add route filters + team owners. If we see kvcache churn again we can flip a cache-size toggle for the canary.
Alex M.: Perfect. If anyone sees anything odd after the dashboard PR ping here and I’ll prioritize. :thumbsup:
